Change-Management Strategy: Mandatory Rollout via Certification, Not Big-Bang The rollout is **not** a global “Day 1 mandate.” It is a **B0 → B1 → B2 → B3 certified corridor** with the following strategic rules. #### A. Mandatory Without Trust Damage: The Transition-Window Covenant - **No B0 cluster receives a mandate release**. B0 clusters (all P-O, P-C, P-R at start) receive only a **pilot-transition-window notice** with a visible **B1 qualification pathway**. - **Usage metrics are capped and geo-traced** during transition windows. Every self-reported usage state, resistance-submission state, and manager-contract state is mapped to jurisdiction with upstream global-tool/dependency flagged. Raw usage metrics **do not feed performance dashboards** in B1 or B0 clusters. - **Local Credibility Reservation** is held per cluster (reserve capital/liquidity for resistance-viral crisis, manager-strike crisis, regulatory-intervention crisis). The global group cannot raid this reserve for cross-market subsidy. - **Group Capital Capacity Commitment** protects the global AI-tool/reputation treaty: the core toolkit (GCBC) is preserved, but the group accepts localized LMOC failures without portfolio collapse. #### B. Covert Use Management: Shadow Integration Corridor (P-C Protocol) Covert use is **not punished**; it is **audited and converted**. - **Shadow-AI Mapping (Corridor B)**: Identify unauthorized endpoints, personal-account integrations, and unofficial workflows without disciplinary exposure. - **Manager-Tacit Covenant Execution**: Local managers in H-C receive formal veto/consultation rights over mandate-release rules in exchange for **disclosing hidden-dependency flows** (data leaving jurisdiction, unofficial model access). - **Metric Decoupling**: In P-C, performance dashboards **exclude raw usage counts**. Instead, dashboards track **local-productivity-correlation metrics** (output quality, error-rate reduction, client-service speed) verified by the manager-council. The hidden-tool transparency portal shows the share of work processed through audited vs. unaudited pathways. - **Data-Decoupling Verification**: Local data-residency infrastructure is built before B2 promotion. The audit confirms granular local-data/narrative disclosure is operational. #### C. Resistance Management: Sovereignty & Collective Trust Protocol (P-R Protocol) Resistance is treated as a **legitimate organizational-trust divergence**, not insubordination. - **Full Resistance-Range Audit (Tier C)**: Social/internal-listening + ground-truth professional-culture correlation identifies boycott-speed triggers (headcount-fear narratives, privacy-sovereignty claims, foreign-tool-stigma). - **Union/Professional-Council Covenant with Veto Rights**: In H-R, rollout mandates, hidden-dependency disclosure access, and crisis-notification participation require **signed collective-council agreement**. No B2 without it. - **Performance-Metric Decoupling Verified**: Usage metrics are **explicitly excluded** from performance evaluation in P-R. Local-performance facilities measure **professional-output sovereignty indicators** (client satisfaction, risk-assessment accuracy, regulatory-compliance quality) calibrated by local champions. - **Sovereign-Data Facility Execution**: Local parameterization requires local training-data provenance disclosure, local-language model adaptation, and jurisdiction-resident compute. The hidden-global-tool audit shows Western-dependency share below certified threshold. - **Crisis-Protocol Activation**: Pre-authorized response for solidarity-strike (employee-blockade of systems), regulatory-nationalization (privacy authority suspension), and hidden-tool exposure (data-breach revealing global dependency). #### D. Open-Adopter Calibration: Preventing Metric Gaming (P-O Protocol) Even open clusters carry integrity risk. - **Peer-Advocate Covenant**: Adoption is peer-led, not HQ-mandated. Peer-advocates verify that usage translates into **verified quality-output**, not mere metric inflation. - **Dashboard Transparency Audit**: Usage metrics are visible but **correlated with quality-degradation checks** (burnout indicators, error-spikes, client-complaint correlation). - **Hidden-Tool Audit**: Even in P-O, Western-calibrated productivity triggers (Anglo-American workflow imagery, individualist-output taxonomy, USD-cloud dependency) must fall below the 20% certified threshold with local workflow dossier visible. --- ### 4.
